    \"    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);\",
    \"    long sz = ftell(f);\",
    \"    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);\",
    \"    uint8_t* buf = malloc(sz);\",
    \"    if(fread(buf, 1, sz, f) != (size_t)sz) { perror(\\\"fread\\\"); return 1; }\",
    \"    fclose(f);\",
    \"    LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(buf, sz);\",

    \"}\",
])
